about: C library functions that contain 68040-unimplemented FPU instructions and may stay reachable from engine code, each with the callers allowed to use it and why (tools/check_fpu_unimplemented.py; ENGINE-FPU-UNIMPL-31). Any other path from engine code fails the build. Text/number conversion is the engine's own (aw_format.c: Q_strtod, Q_sscanf, Q_fscanf, and Q_vsnprintf behind the printf family via the link's --wrap), so the C library's strtod, scanf and printf code (_strtod_l, _dtoa_r, _svfprintf_r, _vfprintf_r, __fixdfdi) is not linked; adding it back fails the build. On a 68040 without an FPU support library these paths still stop the game when executed (ENGINE-FPSP-MISSING-31).
